(repo/'README.md').write_text('''# Teaser Editing Skills

Two complementary Codex skills for turning long interviews and podcasts into compelling short teasers, including Hebrew and RTL footage.

| Skill | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [strategic-teaser-compression](skills/strategic-teaser-compression/SKILL.md) — בחירת קטעים מעניינים ביותר ודחיסה אסטרטגית שלהם | Select strong moments across the full recording and assemble an honest question–answer chain, escalating stakes and a deliberate open payoff. |
| [visual-teaser-editing](skills/visual-teaser-editing/SKILL.md) — עריכה ויזואלית | Align semantic B-roll, motion graphics, typography and changes of state to the selected dialogue. |

Use the selection skill first, then the visual skill once the narrative and output timing are stable. Both preserve the original project, transcript and earlier sequences when working in OpenCut/POCUT.

## Included

- Both complete `SKILL.md` instructions and Codex UI metadata.
- Detailed Hebrew reference analyses of content structure and visual editing.
- Twelve reference frames linked from the visual analysis.
- A synthetic source-to-output ledger and Python timing checker.

The analyses distinguish observed teaser evidence from assumptions about the unavailable long recording. The full source video is not included.

## Install

Clone this repository using your authenticated GitHub account:

```sh
gh repo clone itayzrihan/teaser-editing-skills
cd teaser-editing-skills
mkdir -p "${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/skills"
cp -R skills/strategic-teaser-compression "${CODEX_HOME:-$HOM
